title: heterotaxis longifolia
intro: Heterotaxis longifolia, commonly known as False Cinnamon or Canela Falsa, is a plant species native to South America, belonging to the family Rutaceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in relieving digestive issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of Heterotaxis longifolia include analgesic, antiseptic, and carminative properties, making it effective in reducing pain, preventing the growth of microorganisms, and easing digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of the plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and limonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
